title: YouTube Autocomplete with FlashData
description: Get your FlashData API key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys (sign in or create an account first). Enter the required query input and your own FlashData API key below. Optional settings can be left unchanged. Click Start to run one YouTube Autocomplete request, then open the run’s Dataset for results or OUTPUT for the complete JSON response. FlashData Credits and Apify resource usage are billed separately; no Actor service fee is added.

query.title: Query
query.description: Enter one phrase to expand, for example: battery recycling. Returns autocomplete suggestions, not video results. Do not paste multiple phrases.

flashdataApiKey.title: Your FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Get your key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys (sign in or create an account first), then create or copy a key with YouTube Autocomplete (youtube_suggestions) permission. Paste the full key starting with fd_ here, without quotes or a Bearer prefix. Use your own FlashData key, not your Apify token. This field is encrypted; no working key is provided. Clicking Start uses your FlashData Credits.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code, for example en (English), de (German), or es (Spanish). For captions, the selected track must already exist; this does not translate or generate content.
language.sectionDescription: The required inputs above are enough for a first run. Change these settings only when your workflow needs them.

region.title: Region
region.description: Two-letter region code, for example US (United States), GB (United Kingdom), or SG (Singapore).
